## About The Author

Image 5: Stephen King

© Shane Leonard

Stephen King

Stephen King is the author of more than sixty books, all of them worldwide bestsellers.His recent work includes _Never Flinch_, the short story collection _You Like It Darker (_ a _New York Times Book Review_ top ten horror book of 2024), _Holly_(a _New York Times_ Notable Book of 2023), _Fairy Tale_, _Billy Summers_, _If It Bleeds_, _The Institute_, _Elevation_, _The Outsider_, _Sleeping Beauties_(cowritten with his son Owen King), and the Bill Hodges trilogy: _End of Watch_, _Finders Keepers_,and _Mr. Mercedes_(an Edgar Award winner for Best Novel and a television series streaming on Peacock). His novel _11/22/63_ was named a top ten book of 2011 by _The New York Times Book Review_ and won the _Los Angeles Times_ Book Prize for Mystery/Thriller. His epic works _The Dark Tower_, _It_, _Pet Sematary_, _Doctor Sleep_, and _Firestarter_ are the basis for major motion pictures, with _It_ now the highest-grossing horror film of all time. He is the recipient of the 2020 Audio Publishers Association Lifetime Achievement Award, the 2018 PEN America Literary Service Award, the 2014 National Medal of Arts, and the 2003 National Book Foundation Medal for Distinguished Contribution to American Letters.He lives in Bangor, Maine, with his wife,novelist Tabitha King.

## Raves and Reviews

“The murders are swift. Unceremonious. Random. Executed with a chilling detachment… the cinematic style we crave from a Stephen King novel.”_—The New York Times Book Review_

 “Classic... Readers will enjoy the very Kingly ending.” —Associated Press

 “The master of horror has proven to be scarily good at the mystery thriller, too. He’s not the King for nothing.”_—USA Today_

 “A real narrative fireworks show… a page-turner.” _—Vanity Fair_

 "Cinematic, propulsive."—Elisabeth Egan,_The New York Times_

 “Holly is, in a way, the quintessential King protagonist: an ordinary (albeit quirky), unprepossessing person who, in the clutch, discovers untapped reserves of smarts and, most important of all, courage.” —Laura Miller,_Slate_

 “Gripping… the master of the macabre has done it again with his latest novel—_Never Flinch_ is a pulpy, fast-paced mystery in King’s unmissable style.”_—_ AARP

 “You always get your money’s worth with mega-bestselling author Stephen King.” _—The Minneapolis Star Tribune_

 “Stephen King writes too many books for so many of them to continue to be this good… witty and propulsive.” _—The Boston Globe_

 “A nailbiter… the propulsive plot will keep you turning pages long past your bedtime. King’s evocative prose still makes characters come alive and ensures that they linger long after their stories are over… I couldn’t put it down.” _—The Washington Post_

 “Stephen King is a writer of towering brilliance whose fiction appeals to a reading public both popular and serious.”_—The Spectator_

 “Breathtaking… King shines when it comes to depicting evil, so it’s no surprise that he’s created two chilling killers... haunting.”_—BookPage_

 “As both narratives unfold, they barrel toward an explosive collision with a thrilling conclusion.”_—AV Club_

 “There's no doubt he's still at the top of his game.” _—Screen Rant_

 “King does some great work here… the threads pull together more and more tightly as the story comes to an (almost) heart-stopping conclusion… an outstanding contribution to American fiction.” _—Crime Fiction Review_

 “King has proven over and over again that you simply can’t miss whatever he comes up with next.” _—Paste Magazine_

 “Explosive and shocking.”_—Men’s Health_

 “The indisputable king… a new Stephen King novel is a special event.” _—Den of Geek_

 “Fascinating.”_—Vulture_

 “There is real suspense in the dual narratives and the actions of an increasingly off-kilter villain. Fans will find a lot to love here.”_—Library Journal_

 “A dark, fast read… will keep King fans turning the pages.”_—Variety_

 “Chilling… another goosebump-worthy ride…”_—Her Campus_

 “King keeps us in a constant state of edge-of-our-seat suspense. This is Stephen King at his finest, and an absolute must-read for his fans.”_—Booklist_

 “Elegantly structured and sharply written, this moody mystery from the master of horror is a must-read.” —_Publishers Weekly_, STARRED review
